title: Simulator hot pixel row check lets a hot pixel land one row below the frame
summary: The hot pixel loop of create_frame() in indigo_ccd_simulator.driver skips a pixel with 'y > frame_height' where 'y >= frame_height' is meant, so a hot pixel whose binned row equals the bottom edge of a sub-frame is written one row below the frame; the frame buffer is the unbinned size, so for most columns the write lands in its slack, but columns beyond 1439 of a full-width row reach past the buffer. Found by source audit next to the binning change, not reproduced; out of the binning task's scope. Next: change the comparison and add a sub-frame hot pixel case to test_ccd_simulator.
evidence: indigo_drivers/ccd_simulator/indigo_ccd_simulator.driver, hot pixel loop in create_frame() ('if (x < 0 || x >= frame_width || y < 0 || y > frame_height)'); quality-review.md of task 20261027140318-5859-fix-simulator-binning
